description: Fill multiple form fields (inputs, selects, checkboxes, textareas) and optionally submit in a single tool call. Compatible with React Hook Form, Vue, and standard HTML5 forms.

fields.description: List of fields to fill: [{selector: '@1' or '#id', value: 'my text', clear: true}]

value.description: Value to set (string, boolean for checkbox, etc.)

pressEnter.description: Press enter on the last input after filling (default: false)

submitSelector.description: Optional selector or snapshot ref (e.g. '@4') of submit button to click after filling
